assets.scope: maze/deep-bellow etc. random pool (rarity=1, level_range {3,nil}); non-unique native-tall corrupted horror; FLAT TOKEN REPAINT after the user decision of 2026-10-04. The shipped flat token (art/monster-batch-g/masters/dremling-v2.png, produced by the monster-batch-g-2/-2b/-2c redraw chain) is a PALE grey-white creature holding an AXE, which contradicts dremling's own desc ('A giant black-skinned humanoid covered in spikey scabrous deposits. Its face is featureless; its eyesockets, empty and hollow.'). The accepted dremling STANDEE (art/token-layers/dremling/standee/master-v1.png) is black-skinned with pale scabrous spikes, a featureless mask face and no weapon, and the user chose to keep it. This repaint brings the flat token back to the desc and the standee: black skin, pale scabrous spike deposits, featureless face with hollow eye sockets, no axe or other weapon. The old master is archived under art/monster-batch-g/superseded/dremling-v2.png and the old 128px runtime token under art/monster-batch-g/superseded/dremling-v2-runtime-128.png. Flat-token size/canvas/format and the manifest mapping are unchanged; only the pixels are repainted.

sources.anchor: desc = _t"A giant black-skinned humanoid covered in spikey scabrous deposits.

references.note: Approved disc, light, camera and matte miniature finish; do not copy its creature. Match this disc's own lightness EXACTLY -- do not darken it further.

dremling's actual native sprite (filename-swap trap: drem's own file is npc/horror_corrupted_dremling.png). A hunched near-black humanoid with a spiky scabrous ridge crest and hollow empty eye sockets. Keep this silhouette and black value; do NOT copy the waraxe this native art happens to hold -- the desc and the accepted standee have no weapon.

The ACCEPTED dremling standee for this same identity (upright master). Match its appearance contract: black skin, broad pale ash-bone scabrous spike deposits along skull, shoulders and forearms, a featureless mask face with hollow sockets, empty clawed hands, no weapon. Camera/disc come from the style reference, not from this upright master.

prompt_fields.subject: A hulking, broad-shouldered giant humanoid seen from a steep overhead three-quarter angle, its skin deep BLACK charcoal with a cool dark-slate-blue cast, crusted all over with thick PALE ash-bone scabrous deposits and jagged spike ridges along the skull crown, spine, shoulders and forearms. Its face is entirely featureless and mask-like -- no eyes, no nose, no mouth, only two deep empty hollow eye sockets. Its hands are empty hooked claws; it carries NO axe, NO waraxe and no weapon or tool of any kind. Broad pale scabrous plates and a pale bone-grey rim light on the upper-left surfaces keep the dark body readable as one crisp shape at small size.
prompt_fields.contrast: Fourth horror/corrupted silhouette alongside Horned Horror (horned minotaur), The Mouth (wide red toothed mass) and The Abomination (tall pale spire): dremling keeps its hulking humanoid-with-spiky-ridge-crest-and-blank-mask silhouette. This repaint deliberately REVERSES the superseded pale-stone value chosen by monster-batch-g-2/-2b/-2c: dremling must now be BLACK-skinned per its own in-game desc and match the accepted black-skinned standee. It stays readable not by a pale body but by INTERNAL value contrast -- broad PALE ash-bone scabrous deposits and lit facing planes on a black mass -- plus a cool blue-grey cast, never a warm brown and never a flat featureless silhouette. No weapon.
prompt_fields.composition: One compact complete creature on a single circular tabletop disc, steep overhead three-quarter camera; visible clean neutral base ring on every side. Keep the whole creature -- every spike, ridge, limb and claw -- as one rounded mass well inside the inner three quarters of the disc radius, leaving a wide bare ring of base plate on every side; no spike tip, claw or cast shadow may reach the outer sixth of the disc radius or cross the disc edge. Render the neutral disc -- including the whole outer-sixth ring band and the area under the black creature -- at EXACTLY the style reference's own brightness and colour. This is a measured correction: earlier attempts at this identity darkened the disc for contrast against a pale body and overshot the base-lightness gate; here the disc must be left unmodified at reference lightness (a hair lighter if anything, never darker). Do NOT apply any darkening bias, warm cast, glow, bounce-light, gradient, vignette or contact shadow to the disc anywhere. DARK-SUBJECT DISCIPLINE: the near-black body needs a broad pale facing plane and a thin bright bone-grey rim light along its upper-left outline so the silhouette reads as a light-edged shape on the dark disc at 48/64/96 px -- not flat black and not tiny glowing outlines. Do not darken the creature to compensate for the dark disc either.
prompt_fields.palette: Deep near-black charcoal to dark slate-blue skin (clearly black even though it is a real painted surface, not a flat silhouette) with broad PALE ash-bone and ivory-grey scabrous deposits and spikes for internal contrast, hollow eye sockets a shade darker than the surrounding mask, a thin bright bone-grey rim light along the upper-left outline; no bright colour accents anywhere on the body, no glowing eyes, no warpaint. Dry neutral charcoal-brown disc with restrained copper-grey bevel at exactly the style reference's own lightness -- unmodified, no extra darkening bias applied for contrast.

assets.gate_reason: Exact source identity re-verified against game/modules/tome data: name="dremling", type horror / subtype corrupted, unique=false, non-unique native-tall body, nice_tile invis.png + add_mos{image=npc/horror_corrupted_drem.png, display_h=2, display_y=-1}, and desc on the same definition. Filename-swap trap re-confirmed: dremling's real art file is npc/horror_corrupted_drem.png (drem's own file is npc/horror_corrupted_dremling.png); tests/token_mapping.lua locks the negative direction. dremling is already mapped, so this repaint carries the required refinement brief (supersedes the mapped dremling token, names the exhausted monster-batch-g-2c batch, states the design-direction change and pins the earlier receipts/art). Flat token size (128px), RGBA and manifest wiring are unchanged; only the artwork is repainted.

refinement.design_change_reason: The shipped flat token was a PALE grey-white stone creature with a waraxe, produced by the monster-batch-g-2/-2b/-2c redraw chain whose explicit design goal was to move dremling as far as possible OUT of black (the dark-on-dark lesson). The user decision of 2026-10-04 reverses that direction: dremling's own desc says 'A giant black-skinned humanoid covered in spikey scabrous deposits ... featureless ... eyesockets, empty and hollow', the accepted standee is black-skinned with pale scabrous spikes and no weapon, and the user chose to keep the standee. This repaint therefore changes the design direction back to a black-skinned, pale-scabrous, weaponless creature and keeps readability through internal pale scabrous plates and a pale rim light rather than a pale body. It is a repaint of the flat token only; the standee, its layer and the flat-token wiring are unchanged.
